card.name: Words just before gas or vapor
card.fires_on: Small linking words, articles or modifiers right before an expected 'gas', 'gases' or 'vapor', usually after liquid or solid is mentioned. Also 'greenhouse' and 'Water' before gas/vapor.

modes.label: Liquid and gas pairs
modes.description: A linking word or comma after 'liquid' that is about to be followed by gas.
modes.example: which is both liquid water<< and>> gas.

modes.label: Change into a gas
modes.description: 'to' or 'a' in phrases about a solid turning directly into a gas.
modes.example: changing directly<< to>> a gas at atmospheric pressure.

modes.label: Modifier before gas or vapor
modes.description: A modifier or noun such as greenhouse or water that leads into gases or vapor.
modes.example: to reduce the emissions of<< greenhouse>> gases from fires

card.writes: It boosts the chance that the next word is gas, gases or vapor.
card.plain: It fires on the word just before 'gas' or 'vapor' when the text is about liquids turning to gas.
